name: @hauptsache.net/clickup-mcp
description: Search, create, and retrieve tasks and documents, add comments, and track time through natural language commands.

tools.name: getTaskById
tools.description: Get a ClickUp task with images and comments (including threaded comment replies) by ID. Optionally append how long the task spent in each status (include_time_in_status). Always use this URL when referencing tasks in conversations or sharing with others.

tools.name: addComment
tools.description: Add a comment to a specific task, or reply inside an existing comment thread via parent_comment_id. Images written as markdown (local file paths, data URIs or URLs) are uploaded and embedded automatically.

tools.name: editComment
tools.description: Replace the text of an own task comment within a configurable time window (default 24 hours) instead of posting a follow-up comment. Formatting and images are preserved; comments by other users and older comments are refused.

tools.name: updateTask
tools.description: Update an existing task including name, description (append a dated section or replace the whole text), status, priority, dates, tags (replace, or add_tags/remove_tags), assignees by ID, username or email, custom fields, and parent relationships. Images in the description are uploaded and embedded automatically.

tools.name: createTask
tools.description: Create a new task in a specific list with full markdown support, assignment to users by ID, username or email, custom fields, and automatic linking to related tasks. Images in the description are uploaded and embedded automatically.

tools.name: searchTasks
tools.description: Search tasks across the whole workspace with structured filters (assignees, tags, dates, custom fields, lists, spaces, folders, status) that ClickUp applies itself, optionally combined with fuzzy text matching on name, content, tags, assignees and ID (multiple terms, OR logic).

tools.name: searchSpaces
tools.description: Search spaces (projects) by name or ID with fuzzy matching. Without search terms, lists every non-archived space with its folders, lists and folderless lists (no documents; use searchDocuments), within a budget of about 40 requests per call (roughly the first 19 spaces are expanded, further spaces are listed by name and id and the result is marked partial). Automatically fetches the complete tree structure for 5 or fewer matches.

tools.name: getListInfo
tools.description: Get comprehensive information about a list including description, available statuses, space tags, and project context for task creation.

tools.name: updateListInfo
tools.description: Rename a list and/or update its description: append markdown with a timestamp (safe default) or replace the whole description with content (destructive, read it with getListInfo first).

tools.name: getTimeEntries
tools.description: Get time entries for a specific task or all user's time entries with hierarchical display (List -> Task -> User -> Entries). Supports date filtering and team member inclusion.

tools.name: createTimeEntry
tools.description: Create a time entry (book time) on a task for the current user using decimal hours format with optional description and start time.

tools.name: getMembers
tools.description: List the workspace members (or the members of one list) with user_id, email and role, to look up user IDs.

tools.name: getCustomFields
tools.description: List the custom field definitions of a list, folder or space with field_id, type, required flag and the valid options of dropdowns and labels.

tools.name: deleteTask
tools.description: Delete a task (permanent through this tool; ClickUp keeps it in the Trash for 30 days). Two-step: call with confirm=false to preview, then confirm=true after the user approved.

tools.name: moveTask
tools.description: Move a task to another list by changing its home list, without touching other list memberships. No ClickApp needed; optionally pass a destination status and whether to carry custom fields along.

tools.name: addTaskToList
tools.description: Add a task to an additional list while keeping it in its current lists. Requires the Tasks in Multiple Lists ClickApp for the Space.

tools.name: removeTaskFromList
tools.description: Remove a task from an additional list (never its home list). Requires the Tasks in Multiple Lists ClickApp; two-step confirm.

tools.name: startTimer
tools.description: Start a live timer for the current user, optionally on a task. ClickUp allows only one running timer; stop it first with stopTimer.

tools.name: stopTimer
tools.description: Stop the current user's running timer and report the finished entry with task, duration, start and end times.

tools.name: getRunningTimer
tools.description: Get the current user's running timer, if any, including the task and elapsed time.

tools.name: getFolder
tools.description: Get a folder with its space and all of its lists (ids, task counts and URLs).

tools.name: createFolder
tools.description: Create a folder in a space. Returns the folder id and URL.

tools.name: updateFolder
tools.description: Rename a folder.

tools.name: createList
tools.description: Create a list inside a folder (folder_id) or as a folderless list in a space (space_id), with optional markdown description, priority, assignee and due date. Returns the list id, URL and statuses.

tools.name: attachFile
tools.description: Upload a file of any type (PDF, spreadsheet, archive, image, text) to a task from an http(s) URL, a base64 data URI or, on a local server only, a local file path. Size limit set by MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE_MB.

tools.name: getAttachment
tools.description: Fetch a task attachment: images (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP) as images with a thumbnail fallback over the response size limit, text-like files as text, other file types as metadata only.

tools.name: deleteComment
tools.description: Delete one of your own task comments within the edit window (permanent). Two-step confirm: the first call previews, confirm=true deletes.

tools.name: mergeTasks
tools.description: Merge one or more source tasks into a target task (hard to undo). Two-step confirm: the first call previews, confirm=true merges.

tools.name: getTimeInStatus
tools.description: Show how long 1 to 100 tasks spent in each status, with the current status and the status history, using ClickUp's bulk endpoint.

tools.name: searchDocuments
tools.description: Search ClickUp documents by name with fuzzy matching, optionally restricted to one space. Returns doc ids to pass to readDocument.

tools.name: readDocument
tools.description: Get a ClickUp document with page structure and content. Supports reading specific pages and provides complete document metadata with navigation.

tools.name: updateDocumentPage
tools.description: Update an existing document page's content and/or name. Requires both doc_id and page_id from readDocument. Supports append mode to add content without overwriting.

tools.name: createDocumentOrPage
tools.description: Create a new document with its first page (using space_id or list_id), add a page to an existing document (using doc_id), or create a sub-page (using doc_id and parent_page_id). Supports markdown content.

clickup_api_key.title: ClickUp API Key
clickup_api_key.description: Your ClickUp personal API token (Profile → Settings → Apps → API Token). Leave empty to log in with a ClickUp OAuth app instead (see client ID and secret below).

clickup_team_id.title: ClickUp Team ID
clickup_team_id.description: Your ClickUp Team ID (the 7–10 digit number in the URL when in settings). Optional: if left empty, the workspace is detected automatically when your token is authorized for exactly one.

clickup_client_id.title: ClickUp OAuth Client ID
clickup_client_id.description: Optional. Client ID of a ClickUp OAuth app, as an alternative to the personal API key. Run `npx @hauptsache.net/clickup-mcp auth` once in a terminal to log in. The app's redirect URL must be http://localhost:8787/callback.

clickup_client_secret.title: ClickUp OAuth Client Secret
clickup_client_secret.description: Optional. Client secret of the ClickUp OAuth app (used together with the client ID).

clickup_primary_language.title: Primary Language
clickup_primary_language.description: Primary language hint for search optimization (e.g., 'de' for German, 'en' for English)

clickup_comment_edit_window_hours.title: Comment Edit Window (hours)
clickup_comment_edit_window_hours.description: How long after creation editComment may still rewrite one of your own comments. Set to 0 to disable comment editing entirely.

max_upload_size_mb.title: Max Image Upload Size (MB)
max_upload_size_mb.description: Upper bound for a single image uploaded to a comment or task description.
